# Full Kit Marketing

> Full Kit Marketing is a modern marketing consultancy for growing service-based businesses. It specializes in getting businesses with little or no marketing infrastructure fully set up and operating with the systems and roadmap they need to scale. Tagline: "Marketing that levels up your business."

Full Kit pairs senior marketing strategy with hands-on execution. It is industry-agnostic within the service sector and works with companies of 2 to 100 employees that have 0 to 1 in-house marketers. Service areas are drawn on as needed rather than sold as a preset package.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/): Overview of the marketing consultancy, who it serves, and how engagements work.
- [Services](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/services/): The core service areas, how the work is structured, and engagement models.
- [About](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/about/): Background on founder Rachel Beck and the specialist network model.
- [Resources](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/resources/): Marketing references and tools for growing service businesses.
- [Privacy and Cookies](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/privacy/): How visitor data and analytics cookies are handled.

## Service areas

- [Marketing strategy and planning](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/services/#areas): Brand audit and a strategic marketing roadmap tied to business goals.
- [Messaging and positioning](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/services/#areas): Value proposition, differentiation, and a cross-channel messaging framework.
- [Content strategy and creation](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/services/#areas): Content production and distribution to grow audience and loyalty.
- [Marketing operations and automation](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/services/#areas): Web, SEO, tech stack, automation, and AI tools.
- [Reporting and analytics](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/services/#areas): Frameworks and dashboards built around the metrics that matter.
- [Custom brand activations](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/services/#areas): Events and moments that bring the brand to life.
- [PR and Earned Media](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/services/#areas): Public relations and media placements to share your story, raise awareness, and drive demand.

## Working together

- [Monthly retainer](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/services/#how): starting at $3,000 per month for an ongoing strategic partnership.
- [Project engagement](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/services/#how): $175 per hour for defined deliverables.
- [Get in touch](https://www.fullkitmarketing.com/#contact): Contact form, or email rachel@fullkitmarketing.com.
